programme.desc: Mark Lucas and Theresa Connolly fall in love but their overbearing mothers ruin their wedding plans and possibly their future together.

programme.desc: Heartwarming drama with Annabeth Gish. After losing her husband and job, a single mother's life changes unexpectedly while working at a care centre for brain trauma patients.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: During the heat of battle in the midst of the Civil War, a beguilingly innocent colt is born to Union Jim Rabb's beloved mare. Refusing the orders to shoot it, lest it prove a hindrance, Rabb keeps the colt as a consolation in these desperate times-a symbol of hope that leads the men of the First Cavalry on a journey of self-discovery and newfound brotherhood.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: Annie's Point
programme.desc: Richard Eason is flat-out filling his late father's shoes as CEO of an east Coast real estate developing company, so he can't spend nearly as much time with mother Annie and daughter Ella as they would like. Annie is dead-set on visiting a place in California where she and her late husband hoped to build their dream house and convinces Ella, who wants to drop out of school and aspires a singing career, to drive along. Ill-prepared but tempestuously stubborn, they embark on an adventurous road trip, where Ella meets hunky waiter Scott Tardy. Learning Annie needs surgery soon, Richard gives chase.

programme.title: Out of the Woods
programme.desc: Drama with Jason London. A self-absorbed young lawyer with ties to the material things in life gets an eye-opening experience when he visits his nature-loving grandfather.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: Deadly Isolation
programme.desc: Mystery thriller. programme.title: EuroLeague. Virtus Bologna - Zalgiris Kaunas
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Panathinaikos - Virtus
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: World's Biggest Bullshark
programme.desc: Marine Ecologist, Dr. Neil Hammerschlag teams up with former Royal Marine Commando, James Glancy and Evolutionary Biologist, Dr. Toby Daly-Engel to uncover how Big Bull, one of the largest Bull Sharks ever caught, grew to become a giant and find out if there could be more like her.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The long-awaited spinoff of the legendary The Incredible Dr. Pol franchise has finally hatched! Spearheaded by Dr. Pol and his son Charles, the Pol familys three generations are all joining forces to grow their animal loving empire and take on an ambitious new project: transforming 350-acres of undeveloped land into a fully functional family farm!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Wild Lapland
programme.desc: A lyrical portrayal of the enchanting, wild creatures who call Lapland home.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Snow School
programme.desc: When every day is a snow day, school is always in session! Snowy climates can make for harsh living, and adulting is hard no matter where you are, but these young are flourishing; a baby walrus gets a swim lesson from Mom, young stoats' playtime teaches them how to hunt, otter pups take a slide and learn to avoid predators, and owlets practice leaving the nest. We'll also see penguin chicks daring to take the leap, an unlikely team of mismatched teenagers, and others learning how to weather and thrive in the coldest climates, thanks to their snowy homeschooling, some very dedicated parents, and a lot of trial and error.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother. She wakes from hibernation, thin and weary, to guide cubs through a fleeting summer. They need food, and she'll teach them everything, not least of all, avoiding dangerous males during mating season and facing wolves in a deadly fight for food. Every day counts in these forests. When winter returns, only the strong and the wise will endure this wild, unforgiving land.

programme.title: Alaska's Deadliest: Predator Prowl
programme.desc: The biggest state in the union is also home to some of the deadliest predators. Alaska is one of the few remaining true wildernesses left on the planet. With its harsh environment, extreme cold and constant winter darkness it is not a place for the fainthearted. As springtime buds and the sun raises its head above the horizon, the state's predatory carnivores emerge on to the vast landscapes to hunt for food, with wolves, brown bears and wolverines dispatching prey with ease. In the waters along the coastline, giant orcas and salmon sharks track and kill their quarry while tiny terrors hide in the channels and make good use of their venomous attacks.

programme.title: Race to Winter
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. As the first light of spring touches snow-covered landscapes, the race begins. Across fjords, forests, mountains and tundra, animals emerge from hiding to take advantage of summer's fleeting generosity.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: A forensic look at how cheetahs hunt their prey, offering new perspectives on the tactics employed by these expert predators when stalking, chasing and bringing down antelope and wildebeest. Following a young cheetah mother over 18-months as she teaches her three cubs the secrets of the hunt.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Killer Three
programme.desc: This series looks at the natural born killers of the animal kingdom with each episode focusing on a particular, shared aspect of what makes these creatures successful predators. In 'Little Killers', we see how a lack of physical size can be overcome when hunting prey and miniscule attackers are able to bring down prey that are massive in comparison. In 'Speed Kills', the spotlight is shone on those predators who use their incredibly fast skills to catch their food. From the fastest animal on land, the cheetah, to the stargazer fish that dispatches its prey in a tenth of a second to the deadly black mamba, some of these attacks are so fast that they cannot be captured using slow-motion. In 'Hunger Games', the emphasis is placed on the driving force behind the majority of attacks, the desire for food.

From the fastest animal on land, the cheetah, to the stargazer fish that dispatches its prey in a tenth of a second to the deadly black mamba, some of these attacks are so fast that they cannot be captured using slow-motion. In 'Hunger Games', the emphasis is placed on the driving force behind the majority of attacks, the desire for food.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters

programme.desc: Sixth Sense. To win the game of life, it can take more than brute force. Animals with a super-powered sixth sense can get the edge on fast-moving prey, beat the elements, and find food in unlikely places.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: The lines between hunter and hunted become blurred in this epic safari. Hold on to your seats as an elephant charges through the bush with a lion dangling from its tusks. Watch as male leopards engage in a turf war, and a pack of hyenas bully a lion off of his buffalo kill. The safari intensifies as a leopard, wild dogs and hyenas fight for the same kill in an astonishing display of raw nature.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's need to break ground for a new outbuilding that will house incoming livestock and Charles has dreamt up an outrageous idea of what that structure can be - and it just may be just crazy enough to work. At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Catching the world's deadliest snakes is no problem for Simon Keys and his partner Siouxsie Gillett, who round up Durban's ever-growing population of street snakes. With the summer heat enticing the snakes into the city, it's the duo's job to safely catch the slithering creatures and release them safely back into the wild. Entering homes, offices and even factories, the reclusive reptiles seek to find shelter in places you wouldn't think likely. From black mambas to cobras, Simon and Siouxsie have their work cut out as they race to help the residents of Durban stay safe from a potentially lethal snakebite.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: This family farm needs a barn! The Pols are ready to tackle their next big project: preserving and carefully taking down a 100-year-old barn since, with every piece they remove makes the barn weaker and weaker. There is no room for error if they are going to transport these irreplaceable beams back to the farm and restore it to its former glory.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Coasts. From the frozen Arctic Ocean, where polar bears and reindeer battle for survival, to the warm beaches of the Mediterranean, home to pink flamingos and killer corals, Europe's coastline attracts a staggering array of wildlife.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx

programme.title: Reptile Planet
programme.desc: Skittering, swimming and even gliding, over 12,000 species of reptiles roam the world. Crocs, turtles, snakes and lizards have ancestors as old as the dinosaurs and evolution as their friend. These cold-blooded creatures have adapted in clever and lethal ways, from armoured skin and poisonous venom to record-breaking bite force and even blood squirting eyes. This is Reptile Planet!

programme.title: Python Invasion
programme.desc: Scientists and hunters team up to fight one of the biggest ecological threats to the Florida Everglades: the Burmese python. In the 1990s, pet pythons were released into the wild and have eaten their way through the food chain. Today, nobody knows how many there are, but estimates may be in the hundreds of thousands. We follow the scientists as they track, gather data, and try to understand better how Pythons reproduce and adapt in the Everglades. Ian Bartoszerk and his team at the Conservancy of Southwest Florida use male scout snakes to lead them to females with the potential to lay up to eighty eggs at a time. At the U.S.G.S., Amy Yackle and Mark Sandfoss work in tandem with wildlife biologists from the National Park Service and the University of Florida to battle female reproduction on another front — Alligator Alley.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Spring rains bring new opportunities and hope to the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Winter. Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: With leopards in its mountains, blue whales off its coasts, and foxes roaming its city centres, Europe is a continent full of wild surprises. From the frozen glaciers of Iceland to the lush islands of the Azores, and from the rugged peaks of the Caucasus to the metropolis of London, the first episode in this stunning series highlights Europe's astonishing diversity, all shot with breath-taking brio and the latest technology to reveal the continent and its animals in all its breath-taking glory.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar's Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can't escape the harsh merciless winter. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt… or die trying.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: Will Smith, Margot Robbie, Jared Leto e Viola Davis nel cinecomic premiato con l'Oscar al trucco. Un team di supercriminali viene reclutato dall'Intelligence per una rischiosa missione.

programme.title: John Wick - Capitolo 2
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves torna a vestire i panni del killer nel sequel con Riccardo Scamarcio e Claudia Gerini. Un debito con un boss camorrista costringe John Wick a impugnare nuovamente le armi.

programme.title: Come fratelli
programme.desc: Due amiche rimangono incinte contemporaneamente e muoiono in un incidente. I loro rispettivi mariti, lasciati soli ad affrontare la sfida di essere padri e vedovi, decidono di unire i loro sforzi per crescere i figli.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume: Il gioco delle coppie
programme.desc: La Commissaria Fusco e i suoi agenti indagano sulla misteriosa scomparsa di una donna. Pasquali fa di tutto per scampare al matrimonio con Susanita, escogitando scuse sempre più improbabili pur di rimandare l'inevitabile.

programme.title: Speciale - I Delitti Del Barlume - Le Nuove Storie
programme.desc: - Speciale - I Delitti Del Barlume -... (ITA 2025) (ITA 2025) (ITA 2025) (ITA 2025) (ITA 2025) (ITA 2025) (ITA 2025) (ITA 2025) (ITA 2025) (ITA 2025).

programme.title: Il ciclone
programme.desc: In un paesino della Toscana vive la famiglia Quarini, il padre Osvaldo e i tre figli Levante, Libero e Selvaggia. Un giorno una compagnia spagnola di flamenco arriva e porta nuovo e contagioso entusiasmo nella vita dei quattro.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: 10 giorni con Babbo Natale
programme.desc: Alessandro Genovesi dirige una commedia natalizia 'on the road' con Fabio De Luigi, Diego Abantantuono e Valentina Lodovini, premiata con il Nastro d'Argento. In camper verso Stoccolma, la famiglia Rovelli investe un uomo che è convinto di essere Babbo Natale.

programme.title: Black Bag - Doppio Gioco
programme.desc: Black Bag - Doppio Gioco.

programme.title: Amore, cucina e curry
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Chocolat", commedia sull’arte culinaria con Helen Mirren. Preoccupata dalla concorrenza, una chef dichiara guerra a un bistrot indiano. Ma sottovaluta il talento del rivale.

programme.title: Trust
programme.desc: Una star di Hollywood, vittima di uno scandalo mediatico, si rifugia in un cottage isolato ma finisce dalla padella nella brace, mentre scopre l'identita' di chi sta cercando di eliminarla. Con Sophie Turner, la Sansa Stark de "Il Trono di Spade".

programme.title: Anche se è amore non si vede
programme.desc: Commedia degli equivoci con Ambra Angiolini, Ficarra e Picone. Due amici d'infanzia, uno fidanzato fedele, l'altro single impenitente, accompagnano gruppi di stranieri in giro per la citta'.

programme.title: Lucy
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Morgan Freeman nel fanta-action di Luc Besson. Un criminale inietta una misteriosa sostanza chimica nel corpo di una studentessa che sviluppa poteri sbalorditivi.

programme.title: Il quinto potere
programme.desc: Il fenomeno WikiLeaks nel thriller biografico con Benedict Cumberbatch. La storia della piattaforma online e del suo fondatore Julian Assange che ha fatto tremare i governi del mondo.

programme.title: Il mio nome e' Nessuno
programme.desc: Terence Hill e Henry Fonda nello 'spaghetti western' restaurato di Tonino Valerii, prodotto da Sergio Leone. Un anziano pistolero affronta l'ultima impresa prima di lasciare il Far West.

programme.title: Mi chiamo Francesco Totti
programme.desc: Francesco Totti si racconta nel documentario di Alex Infascelli. Nella notte che precede l'addio al calcio, il capitano della Roma ripercorre le emozioni della sua vita privata e sportiva.

programme.title: Speciale - Gomorra - Le Origini
programme.desc: Tutti i segreti del dietro le quinte di Gomorra Le Origini, la serie che racconta l’iniziazione criminale di Pietro Savastano.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Un immenso Jim Carrey nella sconvolgente metafora dei nostri tempi. Dal giorno della nascita, a sua insaputa, Truman vive sorvegliato dalle telecamere nel piu' estremo dei reality show.

programme.title: Il socio
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di John Grisham, thriller di Sydney Pollack con Gene Hackman e Tom Cruise. Assunto da un prestigioso studio legale, un avvocato inesperto viene coinvolto in loschi intrighi.

programme.title: La luce sugli oceani
programme.desc: Michael Fassbender e Alicia Vikander in un dramma sulla pericolosa scelta di una coppia. Un guardiano del faro e sua moglie salvano una neonata alla deriva e la crescono in segreto.

programme.title: Giurato numero 2
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: Il quinto potere
programme.desc: Il fenomeno WikiLeaks nel thriller biografico con Benedict Cumberbatch. La storia della piattaforma online e del suo fondatore Julian Assange che ha fatto tremare i governi del mondo.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket (Edizione Deluxe)
programme.desc: La 'sporca guerra' secondo Stanley Kubrick in un film epocale con Matthew Modine. Al campo di addestramento di Parris Island il severissimo sergente di ferro Hartman addestra diciassette reclute a diventare spietati marines: i suoi metodi, durissimi e mortificanti, sono in grado di trasformare i soldati in vere e proprie macchine da guerra, pronte per affrontare l'orrore del conflitto in Vietnam. Come il soldato Joker e il soldato Cowboy che si ritroveranno al fronte, nel cuore del paese di Ho Chi Minh, nel mirino di un misterioso cecchino viet cong.

programme.title: Red Snake
programme.desc: Un cast femminile per entrare nel cuore del conflitto in Kurdistan. Venduta come schiava del sesso a un combattente dell’Isis, una ragazza yazida si unisce a un gruppo di guerrigliere.

programme.title: Schindler's List - La lista di Schindler
programme.desc: 7 Oscar al kolossal di Steven Spielberg con Liam Neeson e Ben Kingsley. La vera storia del tedesco Oskar Schindler che salvò centinaia di ebrei dalla Shoah, impiegandoli nella sua fabbrica.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: Il tempo che ci vuole
programme.desc: Toccante film autobiografico di Francesca Comencini con Fabrizio Gifuni e Romana Maggiora Vergano. Sullo sfondo degli anni 70, tra la magia del cinema, gli anni di piombo e il tunnel della droga, la regista narra il suo complesso rapporto con il padre Luigi.

programme.title: Il Kaiser - Franz Beckenbauer
programme.desc: Biopic Sky Original che racconta l'ascesa di Franz Beckenbauer. Un viaggio nella vita e nella carriera di una leggenda del calcio tedesco, campione del mondo da giocatore e da allenatore.

programme.title: Zero Dark Thirty
programme.desc: 1 Oscar per il thriller di Kathryn Bigelow con Joel Edgerton e Jessica Chastain, premiata ai Golden Globe. Un team della Cia collabora con i Navy Seals per catturare Osama Bin Laden.

programme.title: Il campione
programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.title: Il quinto potere
programme.desc: Il fenomeno WikiLeaks nel thriller biografico con Benedict Cumberbatch. La storia della piattaforma online e del suo fondatore Julian Assange che ha fatto tremare i governi del mondo.

programme.title: Eden
programme.desc: Diretto da Ron Howard, un avvincente thriller basato su una storia vera con Jude Law e Vanessa Kirby. Dopo la crisi del 1929, il dottore e filosofo Friedrich Ritter decide di lasciare la Germania e di trasferirsi in un'isola remota delle Galapagos.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: Fuori
programme.desc: Valeria Golino, Elodie e Matilda De Angelis, premiate con il Nastro d'Argento, nel film di Mario Martone dal romanzo autobiografico di Goliarda Sapienza. 1980: in carcere, la scrittrice instaura un legame di sorellanza con due detenute che continua quando le donne ritrovano la libertà.

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: Judi Dench nella storia di una spia del KGB. Sottoposta a interrogatorio, l'insospettabile vedova Joan Stanley ripercorre la sua lunga militanza al servizio del regime comunista.

programme.title: È stato tutto bello - Storia di Paolino e Pablito
programme.desc: Walter Veltroni racconta in un documentario la vita e la carriera di Paolo Rossi, uno degli eroi della nazionale italiana che trionfo' ai Mondiali di calcio del 1982.

programme.title: Zero Dark Thirty
programme.desc: 1 Oscar per il thriller di Kathryn Bigelow con Joel Edgerton e Jessica Chastain, premiata ai Golden Globe. Un team della Cia collabora con i Navy Seals per catturare Osama Bin Laden.

programme.title: Itaca. Il Ritorno
programme.desc: Il poema omerico nella rilettura di Uberto Pasolini che mette in scena il ritorno di Ulisse nella sua Itaca dopo 20 anni di lontananza, ma il suo regno è profondamente cambiato ed è minacciato dai Proci.

programme.title: La stanza accanto
programme.desc: Tilda Swinton e Julianne Moore in un dramma di Pedro Almodovar, Leone d'Oro a Venezia. Martha è una reporter di guerra malata di cancro che ha deciso di suicidarsi con una pillola. Ingrid, una sua amica di infanzia, passa con lei gli ultimi giorni prima del momento fatale.

programme.title: Attacco a Mumbai - Una vera storia di coraggio
programme.desc: L’inferno del terrorismo in un infuocato dramma tratto da una storia vera, con Armie Hammer e Dev Patel. Nel novembre 2008 un gruppo di jihadisti armati sbarca a Mumbai per compiere una serie di attentati in vari punti della città e prendere d’assalto un storico albergo di lusso.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. programme.title: Conclave
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe all'acclamato film di Edward Berger ambientato nel mondo della Chiesa con Ralph Fiennes, Stanley Tucci, Sergio Castellitto e Isabella Rossellini.

programme.title: Iddu - L'ultimo Padrino
programme.desc: Toni Servillo ed Elio Germano nel film liberamente ispirato ad un periodo della vita di Matteo Messina Denaro. Sicilia: in cambio della libertà, un politico condannato per associazione mafiosa collabora con la giustizia per catturare il boss latitante.

programme.title: Margin Call
programme.desc: Kevin Spacey, Paul Bettany e Jeremy Irons in un thriller ambientato a Wall Street. All'alba della crisi finanziaria, un gruppo di manager ha 24 ore per evitare il fallimento di una banca.

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: David Cronenberg dirige Viggo Mortensen in un thriller fra apparenza e realtà. Dopo aver ucciso 2 rapinatori per legittima difesa, un uomo si trova braccato da loschi individui.

programme.title: The Alto Knights - I due volti del crimine
programme.desc: Barry Levinson dirige Robert De Niro in un thriller dallo sceneggiatore di "Quei bravi ragazzi". New York, anni 50: per ottenere il controllo del mondo malavitoso, il boss Vito Genovese ordina di uccidere il rivale Frank Costello, che sopravvive miracolosamente all'attentato.

programme.title: We Are Marshall
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Charlie's Angels", un'emozionante storia vera con Matthew McConaughey. Dopo un tragico incidente, un allenatore fa di tutto per ricostruire la squadra di football.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: Keira Knightley nel biopic sulla scrittrice Gabrielle Sidonie Colette. Protagonista della scena artistica nella Parigi della Belle Epoque, divenne un modello di emancipazione femminile.

programme.title: Cattive acque
programme.desc: Mark Ruffalo e Anne Hathaway in un dramma legale di impegno civile, tratto da una storia vera e diretto da Todd Haynes. Rischiando in prima persona, un coraggioso avvocato sfida una potente multinazionale accusandola di aver inquinato per anni l’acqua di una zona degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Il caso Minamata
programme.desc: Johnny Depp nel biopic Sky Original. 1971: il fotografo Eugene Smith indaga sui casi di avvelenamento in un villaggio giapponese, causati dall'inquinamento delle industrie chimiche.

programme.title: Notre-Dame in fiamme
programme.desc: La pellicola Sky Original di Jean-Jacques Annaud sull'incendio che colpi' la cattedrale parigina nel 2019 e su coloro che sfidarono le fiamme per mettere in salvo tesori inestimabili.

programme.title: Bleed - Più forte del destino
programme.desc: Miles Teller nell'esaltante storia del pugile Vinny Pazienza. Reduce da un terribile incidente, il tenace campione non si arrende e torna sul ring per combattere un match leggendario.

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: David Cronenberg dirige Viggo Mortensen in un thriller fra apparenza e realtà. Dopo aver ucciso 2 rapinatori per legittima difesa, un uomo si trova braccato da loschi individui.

programme.title: Il traditore
programme.desc: Marco Bellocchio dirige Pierfrancesco Favino nella biografia del 'boss dei due mondi', Tommaso Buscetta, il primo pentito della mafia, che testimonio' nel maxiprocesso contro Cosa Nostra.

programme.title: The Apprentice - Alle origini di Trump
programme.desc: Sebastian Stan è l’imprenditore e Presidente USA nel biopic di Ali Abbasi. New York, anni 70: l'ascesa del magnate segnata dall'incontro con l'avvocato Roy Cohn (Jeremy Strong).

programme.title: Bullitt
programme.desc: Oscar al montaggio per il poliziesco di Peter Yates con un magistrale Steve McQueen. Il tenente Frank Bullitt viene incaricato della protezione di un pentito, ma non sara' un'impresa facile.

programme.title: Gomorra - Le Origini
programme.desc: Pietro sogna di diventare come il suo idolo, Angelo ‘A Sirena, ma dopo una notte passata al suo fianco, scopre che tutti i sogni hanno un prezzo. Con sottotitoli.

programme.title: Gomorra: Le origini
programme.desc: Angelo riceve un invito che potrebbe migliorare la sua situazione, mentre Pietro si scontra con la realtà e capisce che i sogni non sono per tutti. Con sottotitoli.

programme.desc: Pietro sogna di diventare come il suo idolo, Angelo ‘A Sirena, ma dopo una notte passata al suo fianco, scopre che tutti i sogni hanno un prezzo. Con sottotitoli.

programme.title: Il grande Lebowski
programme.desc: Commedia cult del Fratelli Coen con Jeff Bridges, John Goodman e Steve Buscemi. Drugo, un ex hippie omonimo di un ricco magnate, deve risolvere il caso di un misterioso rapimento.

programme.title: Soldato Jane
programme.desc: Demi Moore e Viggo Mortensen in un film di Ridley Scott. Una donna si sottopone a un addestramento massacrante agli ordini di un sadico istruttore per entrare nei Navy Seals.

programme.title: Starman
programme.desc: Il docufilm di Gianluca Cerasola dedicato a Luca Parmitano, il primo astronauta italiano a diventare comandante della ISS e a battere il record di permanenza extraveicolare nello Spazio.

programme.title: Il mondo perduto: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo diretto da Steven Spielberg, con Jeff Goldblum e Julianne Moore. Due scienziati ostacolano un criminale che vuole trasportare i feroci dinosauri nello zoo di San Diego.

programme.title: Jurassic World - La rinascita
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Mahershala Ali nel settimo kolossal della saga, diretto da Gareth Edwards. Su un'isola abitata da voraci mostri preistorici, una squadra speciale deve estrarre dal sangue delle creature un campione di DNA con cui sviluppare un farmaco rivoluzionario.

programme.desc: 3 Oscar al cult di Steven Spielberg, dal romanzo di Michael Crichton. Uno scienziato crea un parco a tema preistorico, popolato da animali estinti generati in laboratorio.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. Se non trova un lavoro in fretta, rischia di perdere la custodia congiunta del figlio, cosi' accetta di fare il guardiano notturno al Museo di Storia Naturale di New York. Un lavoro tranquillo, pensa Larry, ma gli basta il primo giro di ricognizione per scoprire che al calar del sole le statue dei personaggi famosi e gli animali impagliati prendono vita, creando un discreto caos e dando vita a una serie di incredibili avventure.

programme.title: Smallfoot: Il mio amico delle nevi
programme.desc: Formidabile favola d’animazione che cambia il punto di vista di un’antica leggenda. Migo è un giovane Yeti che vive con il resto della comunità in una città innevata, al di sopra delle nuvole in cima all’Himalaya. Un giorno assiste a un incidente aereo e scopre che il pilota è un essere umano: una specie da sempre considerata un’invenzione. Di ritorno dai suoi simili nessuno gli crede, ma un regista di documentari che da sempre è alla ricerca dell’esistenza del popolo Yeti accetta di seguire Migo fino al suo villaggio per dimostrare che le due specie non sono una leggenda per creduloni.

programme.desc: Commedia di Woody Allen con Jesse Eisenberg, Kristen Stewart e Steve Carell. Anni '30: il giovane Bobby parte per Los Angeles in cerca di fortuna nel cinema e si innamora di Vonnie.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di grigio
programme.desc: Eros e romanticismo per Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan, dal romanzo di E. L. James. Una studentessa viene sedotta da un uomo ricco e misterioso, che la coinvolge in un rapporto trasgressivo.

programme.title: L'amore Che Non Muore
programme.desc: Grande successo in Francia per la pellicola di Gilles Lellouche. Una rapina finita male divide le strade di Jacqueline e Clotaire, ma la forza del primo amore resterà intatta...

programme.title: Un ragazzo d'oro
programme.desc: Sharon Stone in una pellicola di Pupi Avati con Riccardo Scamarcio. Dopo il suicidio del padre scrittore, il figlio tenta di pubblicarne il libro incompiuto scoprendo scottanti verita'.

programme.title: Prima ti sposo, poi ti rovino
programme.desc: George Clooney e Catherine Zeta-Jones in un'esplosiva commedia romantica dei fratelli Coen. Una donna, che colleziona mariti per denaro, si vendica sposando l'avvocato che l'ha incastrata.

programme.title: Terapia di coppia per amanti
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini, Pietro Sermonti e Sergio Rubini in una deliziosa commedia sui tormenti amorosi. Viviana e Modesto, entrambi sposati e con un figlio a testa, sono amanti clandestini da lungo tempo ma la loro relazione sta diventando sempre più complicata ai limiti dell’esasperazione. Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Ma Viviana e Modesto non sono una coppia, almeno ufficialmente. Tratto dall’omonimo romanzo di Diego De Silva, autore della sceneggiatura con il regista Alessio Maria Federici.

programme.title: Mektoub, My Love: Canto Uno
programme.desc: Dal regista de "La vita di Adele", un sensuale film di formazione. Un aspirante sceneggiatore torna nella città d'origine per l'estate dove trova vecchi amori e nuovi amici.

programme.title: Per tutta la vita
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Luca e Paolo, Ambra Angiolini e Claudia Gerini. Quattro coppie ricevono la notizia che il loro matrimonio e' stato annullato e devono ripresentarsi davanti all'altare.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Meryl Streep e Pierce Brosnan nel musical tratto dalle canzoni degli Abba. Per le sue nozze, Sophie invita tre ex amanti di sua madre, sperando finalmente di scoprire chi e' il padre.

programme.title: Am I Ok?
programme.desc: Dakota Johnson in una pellicola sulla scoperta della sessualità. Dopo una serie di appuntamenti fallimentari con uomini, Lucy realizza che dipende da ciò che vuole veramente.

programme.title: Mamma mia! - Ci risiamo
programme.desc: Tornano Amanda Seyfried, Meryl Streep e Colin Firth nel sequel del musical scandito dalle canzoni degli Abba. Sull'isola greca di Kalokairi, Sophie e' alle prese con la ristrutturazione dell'hotel di famiglia e soffre per la mancanza di Sky, partito per uno stage di sei settimane negli Stati Uniti. Il ragazzo vorrebbe che lei lo raggiungesse, ma Sophie non vuole lasciare l'isola per non mancare di rispetto alla madre, Donna, scomparsa un anno prima. Alla vigilia dell'inaugurazione dell'albergo, tuttavia, un violento uragano si abbatte su Kalokairi.

programme.title: C'eravamo tanto amati
programme.desc: Nino Manfredi, Vittorio Gassman e Stefania Sandrelli nel capolavoro di Ettore Scola. La storia di tre amici, ex partigiani, sullo sfondo dell'Italia dal Dopoguerra agli anni 70. Dopo la fine del conflitto Gianni, Antonio e Nicola (Stefano Satta Flores) hanno preso strade diverse: Antonio fa il portantino e Nicola il professore, mentre Gianni è l’unico dei tre che è riuscito a fare carriera. Dopo molti anni, per caso, i tre si incontrano nuovamente. Sceneggiatura dello stesso Scola, con Age & Scarpelli, breve cameo di Vittorio De Sica, scomparso prima dell’uscita del film nelle sale.

programme.title: Prima ti sposo, poi ti rovino
programme.desc: George Clooney e Catherine Zeta-Jones in un'esplosiva commedia romantica dei fratelli Coen. Una donna, che colleziona mariti per denaro, si vendica sposando l'avvocato che l'ha incastrata.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di nero
programme.desc: Tornano Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan nelle avventure sentimental-erotiche tratte dal secondo capitolo della bollente saga letteraria di E. L. James. Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jane Austen, una storia di intese amorose con Gwyneth Paltrow. 1800: una giovane aristocratica inglese aiuta una ragazza timida a trovare l'uomo giusto. Oscar alle musiche.

programme.title: In amore niente regole
programme.desc: George Clooney dirige e interpreta una commedia brillante con Renee Zellweger e John Krasinski. 1925: un capitano di football e un giovane fuoriclasse si innamorano della stessa donna.

programme.title: C'eravamo tanto amati

programme.title: Proposta indecente
programme.desc: Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson e Robert Redford nell'indimenticabile pellicola firmata dal regista di "Nove settimane e mezzo" e "Attrazione fatale". Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. Dopo molti dubbi, Diana e David decidono di accettare l'offerta ma le conseguenze saranno devastanti...

programme.desc: Commedia romantica di e con Giampaolo Morelli e Maria Chiara Giannetta. Dopo una delusione d'amore Guido è diventato cinico, ma l'incontro con Giulia potrebbe fargli cambiare idea.

programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Renato Pozzetto e un grande cast nel film Sky Original ispirato al romanzo di Giuseppe Sgarbi. Dopo la morte della moglie, un uomo ripercorre la storia d'amore di una vita.

programme.title: Il materiale emotivo
programme.desc: Commedia di e con Sergio Castellitto, Berenice Bejo e Matilda De Angelis. Parigi: la vita monotona del proprietario di una libreria riceve una scossa grazie a un'esuberante attrice.

programme.desc: Giampaolo Morelli dirige e interpreta una commedia romantica con Serena Rossi e Diana Del Bufalo. Un giornalista segue un corso di 'arte del rimorchio' per riconquistare la sua ex.

programme.desc: Divertente college movie tra amore e amicizia. Due matricole decidono di rompere con i rispettivi partner durante il Ringraziamento per non avere più vincoli. Ci riusciranno?

programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sofia Coppola per una raffinata commedia romantica con Bill Murray e Scarlett Johansson. A Tokyo per uno spot, un divo americano in declino farà un incontro speciale.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di rosso
programme.desc: Anastasia e Christian, finalmente sposi, credono di essersi lasciati alle spalle il passato, ma un nuovo pericolo minaccia il loro legame.

programme.desc: Irriverente commedia con Gerard Depardieu, diretta e interpretata da Daniel Auteuil. Un uomo sposato, dalla fervida immaginazione, inizia a fantasticare sulla giovane fidanzata dell'amico.

programme.title: La quattordicesima domenica del tempo ordinario
programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Lodo Guenzi, Edwige Fenech e Gabriele Lavia in una storia sul tempo perduto. L'incontro fra due ex amanti riporta alla luce sogni e disillusioni.

programme.title: Appuntamento con l'amore
programme.desc: Un cast di star hollywoodiane per una commedia sul mistero dell'amore. A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

programme.title: Sweethearts
programme.desc: Divertente college movie tra amore e amicizia. Due matricole decidono di rompere con i rispettivi partner durante il Ringraziamento per non avere più vincoli. Ci riusciranno?

programme.title: Quel mostro di suocera
programme.desc: Jennifer Lopez e Jane Fonda in una brillante commedia a tinte rosa. Una ragazza sta per sposare l'uomo ideale, ma l'invadente futura suocera farà di tutto per renderle la vita un inferno.

programme.title: A proposito di Schmidt
programme.desc: 2 Golden Globe al film di Alexander Payne con Jack Nicholson e Kathy Bates. Un vedovo attraversa l'America in un viaggio alla scoperta delle sue emozioni più profonde.

programme.title: La migliore offerta
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige il premio Oscar Geoffrey Rush in un'intensa pellicola. La vita di un antiquario viene sconvolta dal segreto nascosto nei sotterranei di una villa.

programme.title: Tartarughe all'infinito
programme.desc: Aza Holmes, sedicenne affetta da disturbo ossessivo compulsivo e ansia, indaga sulla scomparsa di un miliardario, che è anche il padre di un suo vicino di casa.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.title: Una figlia
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo cresce la figlia in simbiosi dopo la morte della moglie. Quando cerca di ricostruirsi una vita con una nuova compagna, la reazione della figlia metterà a dura prova il suo amore paterno e la sua capacità di perdonare.

programme.title: Un eroe
programme.desc: Grand Prix della Giuria a Cannes per il pluripremiato Asghar Farhadi. Un detenuto rinuncia a una borsa piena d'oro restituendola al proprietario. Diventera' un eroe ma con esiti imprevisti.

programme.title: Gli ultimi saranno ultimi
programme.desc: Dramma sociale di Massimiliano Bruno con Paola Cortellesi e Alessandro Gassmann. La vita di una donna, licenziata perche' incinta, si intreccia con quella di un poliziotto tormentato.

programme.title: Fire Squad - Incubo di fuoco
programme.desc: Spettacolare film drammatico con Jeff Bridges, Josh Brolin e Jennifer Connelly ispirato alle vicende di un gruppo di pompieri addestrati nel combattere gli incendi di montagna. Un pauroso incendio in Arizona sara' la loro tragica prova del fuoco.

programme.title: Orlando
programme.desc: Daniele Vicari dirige una favola moderna con un intenso Michele Placido. In Belgio per rivedere il figlio ricoverato in ospedale, un anziano contadino scopre di avere una nipote.

In un paesino dell'Aspromonte, l'atto intimidatorio del ventenne Leo nei confronti di un clan rivale riunisce dopo molti anni tre fratelli. Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

programme.title: Trilogia di Istanbul - Muhabbet
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek ritorna alla sua terra natale con tre cortometraggi. Una tavola circondata da amici alimenta conversazioni intime che si chiamano Muhabbet.

programme.desc: Matteo Rovere dirige Stefano Accorsi e Matilda De Angelis. Dopo la morte del padre, una ragazza appassionata di motori ritrova suo fratello, pilota provetto diventato tossicodipendente.

programme.desc: Miglior sceneggiatura a Berlino 2019 per il film di Claudio Giovannesi tratto dal bestseller di Roberto Saviano. Napoli: l'ascesa di un gruppo di giovanissimi nel mondo della criminalita'.

programme.desc: Juli Grabenhenrich e Luca Marinelli in un dramma familiare scritto e diretto da Alissa Jung. Una quindicenne tedesca giunge a Rimini per incontrare finalmente il padre biologico italiano, confrontandosi con l'uomo vulnerabile e tormentato che non l'ha mai voluta conoscere.

programme.desc: 1 David di Donatello al film di Giuseppe Bonito dal bestseller di Donatella Di Pietrantonio. Una tredicenne torna dalla sua famiglia biologica, passando da una vita agiata alla poverta'.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Mimi's painting a lovely picture at her hutch, with Jess along for a visit. Suddenly she's collapses in fits of tickly giggles, there are ants everywhere.. Mimi can't paint, tho, whilst she's being tickled and Jess works out they are here for her honey sandwiches!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: The friends are having a tidying up day. programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Poor Willow has a sore hoof and has to stay inside until it's better. Jess works out that they can make beautiful tree and leaf rubbings into a wonderful tree collage for the stable to remind Willow of her orchard.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Mimi has promised Jess a special surprise if he can work out what he likes best about the Spring… He finds out that there's blossom on the trees, fresh new grass, bright young flowers in the Springtime. programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Poor Mimi! Her normally beautiful garden is all messy and full of swirly piles of earth. She's really upset and Jess promises to her help her make it the most beautiful garden ever! Raking away the swirls doesn't work, they just come back! Jess and Mimi realise that worms are making the swirly piles of earth. Mimi wants to move them away but they go back underground before she can catch them. When it rains the worms come back and Jess and Mimi gather up the worms in a bucket and take them to live in the orchard by a patch of scrappy flowers. The garden still isn't looking at it's best though! After the worms have gone Mimi's flowers go all droopy. Willow explains that worms make help make the soil rich and good for plants – and that's what makes the flowers bloom. Jess remembers that the worms had come out when it rained. They water the ground to bring the worms up to the surface again. The worms agree to come back to Mimi's garden and soon her garden is beautiful again. Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess and the pups have been looking after the orchard while Willow's been on holiday but the day she's due back the orchard is full of little piles of earth. What's making them? That's the Big Question. Jess wonders if someone put them there. He asks Mimi, who's making a pile of earth while she digs a hole. She tells him she's going to plant an apple tree. Maybe someone's been planting new apple trees in the orchard thinks Jess. But when he looks carefully there are no holes or newly planted trees. Horace the hoppy frog suggests that maybe it's an invisible digger who's digging underground. Billie the little mouse arrives and tells Jess that the little piles of earth are called molehills. Jess works out that the piles of earth are in a line. Maybe someone is digging a tunnel underground so they can travel right across the orchard. They keep very quiet and a tiny mole pops out above ground. That's who's been making piles of earth in the orchard. They've answered the question. Hooray!

programme.title: Call to Earth: Call to Earth: Reviving India's Waters
programme.desc: Our waterways often bear the brunt of modern-day human negligence. Most of India's ponds, lakes and oceans are polluted or contaminated due to human activity. Led by founder Arun Krishnamurthy, Environmentalist Foundation of India (EFI) focuses on reviving these bodies of water through a community-based conservation effort, with their work now extending into the surrounding forest ecosystems. Arun takes us on a journey across India - from the north in Delhi to the south in Chennai - for a firsthand look at EFI's most critical and ongoing projects, and the tens of thousands of volunteers that make it all possible.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Poor Mimi! Her normally beautiful garden is all messy and full of swirly piles of earth. She's really upset and Jess promises to her help her make it the most beautiful garden ever! Raking away the swirls doesn't work, they just come back! Jess and Mimi realise that worms are making the swirly piles of earth. Mimi wants to move them away but they go back underground before she can catch them. When it rains the worms come back and Jess and Mimi gather up the worms in a bucket and take them to live in the orchard by a patch of scrappy flowers. The garden still isn't looking at it's best though! After the worms have gone Mimi's flowers go all droopy. Willow explains that worms make help make the soil rich and good for plants – and that's what makes the flowers bloom. Jess remembers that the worms had come out when it rained. They water the ground to bring the worms up to the surface again. The worms agree to come back to Mimi's garden and soon her garden is beautiful again. Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess and the pups have been looking after the orchard while Willow's been on holiday but the day she's due back the orchard is full of little piles of earth. What's making them? That's the Big Question. Jess wonders if someone put them there. He asks Mimi, who's making a pile of earth while she digs a hole. She tells him she's going to plant an apple tree. Maybe someone's been planting new apple trees in the orchard thinks Jess. But when he looks carefully there are no holes or newly planted trees. Horace the hoppy frog suggests that maybe it's an invisible digger who's digging underground. Billie the little mouse arrives and tells Jess that the little piles of earth are called molehills. Jess works out that the piles of earth are in a line. Maybe someone is digging a tunnel underground so they can travel right across the orchard. They keep very quiet and a tiny mole pops out above ground. That's who's been making piles of earth in the orchard. They've answered the question. Hooray!

programme.title: CSI S5 E12 - Snakes
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

Who cares if he never finished high school? Thornton’s pockets are deep enough to buy his way in! But when he steals his professor’s girlfriend (Sally Kellerman), Thornton goes just a little too far. Now, he’ll have to hit the books, instead of his bank account – or go back to being the world’s wealthiest dropout!

Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Iron Ball
programme.desc: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. programme.title: Burning Blood
programme.desc: Narcotics squad members—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng, and Ah Tang—are involved in arresting a drug lord. However, a betrayal within the police leads to the deaths of Ah Feng and his superior, while Ah Tang vanishes. As Tai Hua and Lao Mi uncover the truth, they find themselves torn between loyalty and betrayal in their fight against the drug cartel.

programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Journeys in Japan
programme.desc: Kyle Card takes on the San'in Kaigan Geopark Trail trek. From the Tottori-Hyogo border he walks to Kyoto along the sea, up rivers as well as terraced rice fields, and into onsen towns.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: DEEPER LOOK
programme.desc: How can we keep the voices of Hibakushas alive? 80 years after the bombing, are hopes for a nuclear weapons-free world fading? Wake Naoko explains.

programme.title: Dig More Japan
programme.desc: Recovery after an earthquake is always a challenge, but with the power of individuals and the support of others, it is possible. Let's dig a little deeper.

programme.title: Dining with the Chef mini
programme.desc: Featured recipes: (1) Crispy Pork Stir-fry with Myoga and Green Beans (2) Stir-fried Eggplant and Shishito with Miso Sauce. Learn about Japanese home cooking with Chef Saito in five minutes!

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Dining With the Chef
programme.desc: Discover Chef Saito's take on Japan's popular mochi-wrapped ice cream, and learn traditional mochi recipes that bring this classic treat to life.

programme.title: NEWSROOM TOKYO
programme.desc: NEWSROOM TOKYO dives deeper into the day's news with insight and analysis, from the perspective of Japan and the rest of Asia. We put a spotlight on what you need to know to understand the issues.

programme.title: Direct Talk
programme.desc: Nakajima Hiromitsu makes supportive devices for world-class para-athletes such as gold medal-winning wheelchair tennis player Kamiji Yui. He talks about helping them perform at their best.

programme.title: DOSUKOI Sumo Salon 5 minutes
programme.desc: Gyoji use eagle eyes to referee sumo bouts. Each has his own unique style: Some get up close, others watch from afar. A gyoji with an impressive record reveals the secret behind his precision.

programme.title: JAPAN FROM ABOVE: UP CLOSE
programme.desc: This program takes you on an aerial journey across 21st century Japan. Enjoy the bird's-eye view of unique landscapes as well as intimate portraits of the people who inhabit the archipelago.

programme.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE: A Secret Date
programme.desc: It's late at night, when all are fast asleep. A young man and woman huddle together along the veranda outside of a house, attending to a ... rooster. What could the pair be up to?

programme.title: Ama Divers Restoring the Seabed
programme.desc: In 2024, natural disasters devastated the fishing grounds of the ama (free divers) in Wajima, Noto. We follow their efforts to survey the seabed and revive their tradition.

programme.title: Document 72 hours
programme.desc: Streetcars have been rolling through the streets of Kochi City for more than 120 years. For three days, we asked passengers of all ages where they were going and why they chose to travel by streetcar.

programme.title: Piper
programme.desc: Sebuah melodi pemain seruling nan mengusik di sekitar Hamelin membangkitkan suatu warisan nan kelam. Hal ini menyeret seorang ibu dan anak perempuan asal Amerika ke dalam sebuah jaringan rahasia dan teror yang jahat.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Saat seorang pemuda keturunan Afrika-Amerika mengunjungi rumah keluarga pacarnya yang berkulit putih, ia terperangkap dalam situasi berbahaya yang tersembunyi di balik undangan yang ia terima tersebut.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgement Day
programme.desc: Sesosok siborg nan identik dengan siborg yang gagal membunuh Sarah Connor kini harus melindungi putranya yang berusia sepuluh tahun, John, dari siborg lain yang lebih canggih dan kuat.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Meskipun ada yang menganggapnya sebagai pencuri atau pahlawan, pria sederhana ini kelak akan menjadi simbol kebebasan abadi bagi rakyatnya.

programme.title: Moby Dick, Pt 1
programme.desc: Satu-satunya orang yang selamat dari sebuah kapal penangkap ikan paus yang hilang menceritakan kisah tentang obsesi kapten kapalnya untuk berburu seekor paus putih, Moby Dick.

programme.title: Moby Dick, Pt 2
programme.desc: Satu-satunya orang yang selamat dari sebuah kapal penangkap ikan paus yang hilang menceritakan kisah tentang obsesi kapten kapalnya untuk berburu seekor paus putih, Moby Dick.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Deckard Shaw berusaha membalaskan dendamnya kepada Dominic Toretto dan keluarganya untuk saudaranya yang sedang terbaring koma.

programme.sub-title: Sharpen Your Mind!! The Newly Awakened Powers of the Magical Girl
